items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 07 September 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure between Scotland and Iceland as various fronts and troughs affect the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, veering West or Northwest later tomorrow and increasing increasing occasionally 7.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Rain clearing tonight, scattered showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, becoming generally Northwest 5 or 5 later tomorrow night, then decreasing 3 or 4 through Wednesday morning. Backing west or southwest later in the day.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
